summary:
英特爾上季營收與獲利均大幅優於預期，受惠於強勁的營運復甦與成本控管。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）為 0.42 美元，顯著高於預期的 0.22 美元，超出幅度達 94.59%。
• 單季營收達 16.13 億美元，較去年同期大幅成長 25.42%。
• 核心業務展現復甦跡象，成本結構優化帶動獲利能力提升。
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報優於預期釋放了營運觸底反彈的積極訊號，對中短期股價具備支撐與激勵作用。後續應持續追蹤晶圓代工客戶導入進度、毛利率恢復軌跡及個人電腦市場需求復甦的持續性。

需留意：半導體產業競爭依舊激烈，晶圓代工業務持續面臨毛利率壓力。；總體經濟環境不確定性可能影響企業與消費者的 IT 支出。

summary_en:
Intel reported a significant beat on both revenue and earnings, driven by strong operational recovery and cost controls.
• EPS came in at $0.42, significantly beating the estimated $0.22 by 94.59%.
• Quarterly revenue reached $16.13 billion, representing a strong year-over-year growth of 25.42%.
• Core business showed clear signs of recovery, with profitability boosted by optimized cost structures.

ai_view_en:
view: The earnings beat signals a positive operational bottoming out, providing support and incentive for near-to-mid-term stock performance. Key metrics to track moving forward include foundry customer adoption, margin recovery trajectory, and the sustainability of PC market demand.

Watch：Competition in the semiconductor industry remains intense, and the foundry business continues to face gross margin pressures.; Macroeconomic uncertainties could impact enterprise and consumer IT spending.
